must_flag: The build cache stores artifacts under `.buildcache/`. Each entry is keyed by a content hash of its inputs. Because a stale key can silently serve an artifact built from different inputs, every read must validate the key against the current input hash first. A reader that opens an entry while another process is writing it gets a corrupt artifact. For that reason, a write must hold the directory lock before touching any entry. The eviction sweep runs only when free disk space drops below 10%. Each sweep removes entries older than 30 days.
must_pass:
The build cache stores artifacts under `.buildcache/`. Each entry is keyed by a content hash of its inputs.

Every read must validate the key against the current input hash first, because a stale key can silently serve an artifact built from different inputs.

A write must hold the directory lock before touching any entry, because a reader that opens an entry while another process is still writing it would otherwise get a corrupt artifact.

The eviction sweep runs only when free disk space drops below 10%. Each sweep removes entries older than 30 days.

Content hashing makes key collisions negligible in practice, though not impossible.

- **Dry run** — a mode that validates inputs without writing any cache entry.
